%FILENAME%
lanpilot-1.2.0-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst

%NAME%
lanpilot

%BASE%
lanpilot

%VERSION%
1.2.0-1

%DESC%
Web interface for monitoring and remote-controlling game servers LANPilot shows every game server of a LAN party on one dashboard and lets operators change the map, restart a match and manage players. It talks to the servers through their own remote protocols and needs no agent on the game hosts.
